endpoints.name: SaveAllFactoryTradeConfigurations
endpoints.business_purpose: Create or update multiple factory trade value configurations (brand/percentage pairs).

business_logic.operation_summary: Creates or updates trade value configurations. For each brand: if exists, update percentage and modified_date; else create new.
business_logic.preconditions: Valid token. User exists. Non-empty configurations list.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

idempotency.notes: Idempotent for updates. Multiple calls update same records.

endpoints.short_description: Create or update multiple factory trade value configurations (brand/percentage pairs).
endpoints.detailed_description: Create or update multiple factory trade value configurations (brand/percentage pairs). It validates the request, then calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IFactoryTradeValueConfiguration.CreateAsync, IFactoryTradeValueConfiguration.SaveChangesAsync. Persists changes to: FactoryTradeValueConfiguration: INSERT. Possible responses: 200, 400, 401, 500.

error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: Invalid or missing token. [when currentUser == null]

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to create or update multiple factory trade value configurations (brand/percentage pairs).
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to view data, or the required inputs are not available yet

llm_tool_definition.name: factory_trade_value_configuration_save_all_factory_trade_configurations
llm_tool_definition.description: Create or update multiple factory trade value configurations (brand/percentage pairs).

endpoints.name: GetProducts
endpoints.business_purpose: Retrieve list of products for trade value configuration with existing brands and unassigned products.

business_logic.operation_summary: Retrieves all configured brands with their percentage values, plus unconfigured products with 0 value.
business_logic.depends_on_user_context: Resolves the current user from the JWT (getUserByToken / claims)

endpoints.permission_basis: controller menu (inferred; no direct frontend call found)
endpoints.short_description: Retrieve list of products for trade value configuration with existing brands and unassigned products.
endpoints.detailed_description: Retrieve list of products for trade value configuration with existing brands and unassigned products. It calls ICommon.getUserByToken, IFactoryTradeValueConfiguration.GetAllFactoryTradeValueConfigurations, IFactoryTradeValueConfiguration.GetProducts. Possible responses: 200, 401, 500.

error_handling.unauthorized: 401/403: Unauthorized: No token provided. [when current_user == null]
error_handling.exceptions: Caught and returned as 500 with the exception message (catches: Exception)

ai_agent_guidance.use_when: When the user wants to retrieve list of products for trade value configuration with existing brands and unassigned products.
ai_agent_guidance.do_not_use_when: When the user only wants to change data
